name: Youth Tree Team
what_you_do: Do paid green jobs with Trees Atlanta staff to get hands-on experience. Weekly sessions teach job-search skills and money basics.
grades: Currently in high school or about to start high school
who_can_apply: Teens who are in high school or about to start, and at least 14 as of May 1.
duration: 7 weeks, June to mid-July 2027, Monday to Friday, 7:30 am to 12:30 pm
deadline_text: Applications open Nov 15, 2026 and close Feb 5, 2027. Challenge Day Feb 27, 2027. Tree planting Mar 6, 2027. Interviews Mar 8 to Apr 9, 2027.
how_to_apply: Apply online when the link is posted. You must finish every step. These are a required Challenge Day, a required volunteer tree planting and an interview.
notes: Competitive. Not everyone who applies gets a job. Returning members can apply for outside study spots with partner groups. The page says the Challenge Day and tree planting dates may change. Georgia Department of Labor says a work permit (employment certificate) is required for minors under 16, so 14 and 15 year olds need one. A school issuing officer or the county school superintendent gives it.
